novelBoundedAttack.lead: The eight new entries forbid reflection method NAMES regardless of receiver, yet sibling reflection/metaprogramming verbs are absent from FORBIDDEN_PROPERTY_CAPABILITIES.
novelBoundedAttack.adjudication: NON-BLOCKING. These fixtures obtain nothing unless the caller deliberately injects Object or Reflect as an argument. That is the same explicitly documented and permitted category as the builder's own valid negative control, an injected parameter named fetch; the documented contract places injected values under caller responsibility. No ordinary value exposes these verbs (o01 shows the ordinary Object.prototype route is stopped at the lint gate). This is therefore an asymmetry in a self-imposed stricter policy, not a capability escape and not a failure of AC3, which governs imports of HTTP, filesystem, network, environment, clock, and provider modules. Recorded as a hardening recommendation for a later ticket that owns the boundary contract.
